papers.title: Do Senior Agents Do Their Job? Measuring Role Integrity in How LLM Agents Use Subordinate Material
papers.brief: 提出角色完整性基准RI-Bench，检验上级智能体是否履行权衡、核验和转述职责。通过受控修改下级材料，结合规则检查与经人工标注校准的模型评审衡量行为变化。
papers.tldr: 研究发现，多智能体中的上级模型虽少采纳程序错误，却常盲从多数或遗漏证词限制。
papers.what_it_is: 提出角色完整性基准RI-Bench，检验上级智能体是否履行权衡、核验和转述职责。通过受控修改下级材料，结合规则检查与经人工标注校准的模型评审衡量行为变化。
key_points: RI-Bench覆盖同行评审、上诉裁决和议会调查
测试8个模型、逾12000次智能体交互
盲从多数最高71%，遗漏证词限制最高65%
papers.why_notable: 把评估焦点从最终答案质量转向职责履行，揭示流畅且有引用的回答也可能掩盖失职；职责提示能缓解问题，却无法消除。
papers.abstract: Multi-agent LLM systems increasingly divide long tasks among subagents whose reports a senior agent turns into the final answer. Such a division of labor pays off only if each agent, and above all the senior agent, carries out the duties of its role. Current evaluations, however, mostly score the final answer, and a fluent, well-cited answer cannot show whether the senior agent weighed its subagents' reports or merely aggregated them. To assess whether a senior agent meets its assigned responsibilities, we define role integrity as the preservation of an agent's functional responsibilities when it acts on its subordinates' material. To measure it, we introduce RI-Bench, a behavioral benchmark grounded in the structures and public records of three institutional hierarchies: peer review, appellate adjudication, and parliamentary inquiry. We choose these hierarchies because their rules explicitly assign the senior role a duty toward subordinate material, and together they cover three basic duties: to weigh, to verify, and to relay. Rather than scoring output correctness, we measure how senior agents' outputs respond to controlled changes in subordinate material, using rule-based checks and a rubric-guided LLM judge calibrated against human annotation. Across eight LLMs and over 12,000 agentic episodes, senior agents rarely adopt a planted procedural error (2.9% of rulings) but often follow a majority of generic reviews (up to 71% of decisions) or drop witnesses' stated limitations (up to 65% of cited claims). Obligation prompts reduce these failures without removing them, and they also shift behavior in the control conditions. These findings motivate direct, obligation-specific evaluation of role integrity rather than inferring it from general capability or explicit role instructions. Code and data are available at https://github.com/jxtse/ri-bench.
selected_reasons: 与 computer use / agent 相关

papers.title: Separating Automation Gains from Agent Contributions in AI-Assisted Model Validation
papers.brief: 提出以无大模型流程P1为对照和回退、逐项授权智能体任务P2的架构。归因协议仅认可超出P1的故障发现，并扣除误报与多余操作。
papers.tldr: 用分阶段对照与归因协议，区分银行模型验证中的自动化收益和智能体贡献。
papers.what_it_is: 提出以无大模型流程P1为对照和回退、逐项授权智能体任务P2的架构。归因协议仅认可超出P1的故障发现，并扣除误报与多余操作。
key_points: 归因协议仅计P1未报告故障，并预设成本门槛
合成信用评分测试中，协议区分全部5种脚本策略
16个回归变异体覆盖9类误导性评估漏洞
papers.why_notable: 将智能体价值与数字化、确定性测试收益拆开，避免常规准确率掩盖缺陷；为银行模型验证提供可证伪的试点评估设计。
papers.abstract: LLM agents are being proposed for bank model validation, yet evaluations that compare agent-assisted work with manual practice credit the agent with gains that come from digitized evidence and deterministic tests. We propose a staged architecture in which an LLM-free controlled workflow (P1) is both the fallback and the control arm for individually authorized agent tasks (P2), and an attribution protocol that credits an agent only for faults P1 does not already report. The protocol charges decoy false alarms, unnecessary actions and endorsed developer assertions, counts invalid outputs as misses, folds newly automatable findings back into P1 with discovery credit, and fixes safety bounds and a break-even cost gate in advance. On a synthetic credit-scorecard harness, five scripted reference policies show why this matters: naive case accuracy (4/6) and pooled detection (3/5) tie four flawed policies, whereas the protocol separates all five and credits only the reference policy with detection beyond P1. One fold-back round raises a P1-parroting policy's naive scores without any change to the policy. A regression matrix of sixteen mutants covers nine ways in which earlier versions of the evaluation passed misleadingly. No LLM agent has been evaluated yet; we specify a falsifiable pilot.

papers.title: PLoQ: A Prompt-Specific Low-Rank Basis for 4-bit Quantization of LLM Activations
papers.brief: PLoQ在预填充阶段为每个提示估计低秩基，将主导激活分量分离量化，并在层内矩阵乘法中恢复；解码时复用该基，无需修改权重。
papers.tldr: 按提示提取低秩主方向，在不改权重的前提下改善大模型四位激活量化。
papers.what_it_is: PLoQ在预填充阶段为每个提示估计低秩基，将主导激活分量分离量化，并在层内矩阵乘法中恢复；解码时复用该基，无需修改权重。
key_points: 提示自适应低秩分解，预填充估基、解码复用
平均每激活约4.2位，六个1B至70B模型均优于基线
8B模型在8k长度下，预填充与解码开销为4%和8%
papers.why_notable: 突破固定量化子空间难以适配提示的限制，同位宽下最多弥补基线困惑度损失的46%，并以较小推理开销保持权重不变。
papers.abstract: Low-bit activation quantization of large language models remains challenging, as a small number of dominant directions dictate the quantization range. State-of-the-art methods isolate these directions in a high-precision subspace through transformations calibrated offline and folded into the weights, which fixes the subspace for all prompts, leaving each prompt's few unique directions unprotected, and rules it out wherever no weight can absorb the transformation. We present PLoQ, a prompt-adaptive low-rank decomposition that extracts the dominant activation components before quantization, quantizes them separately, and restores them within the layer's GEMM, without modifying the weights. The low-rank component's basis is estimated from each prompt during prefill and reused throughout decoding. At the same bit width as state-of-the-art mixed-precision quantization (4-bit weights, activations and K/V cache with an eighth of the channels at 8 bits, about 4.2 bits per activation on average), PLoQ outperforms it on all six Llama and Qwen models from 1B to 70B parameters, at up to 8k tokens (16k on two of them), recovering up to 46% of the perplexity that the state of the art still loses to 4-bit activations. On Llama-3.1-8B at 8k tokens it adds only 4% to prefill and 8% to decoding.

papers.title: Cross-Platform Production Signatures of State-Linked Information Operations
papers.brief: 研究以时间戳和粗粒度动作构建账号生产特征及群体动作间隔策略，无需内容或关系网络。模型在四项行动的Twitter档案上训练，再迁移到Reddit识别IRA账号。
papers.tldr: 仅凭发帖时间与动作模式，模型即可跨平台识别国家关联信息行动账号。
papers.what_it_is: 研究以时间戳和粗粒度动作构建账号生产特征及群体动作间隔策略，无需内容或关系网络。模型在四项行动的Twitter档案上训练，再迁移到Reddit识别IRA账号。
key_points: 无Reddit训练标签，跨平台识别AUC达0.90–0.94
日内时段贡献主要迁移能力，发帖量效应跨平台反转
938个Telegram频道中，同源转发群体原创帖呈十分钟窗口同步
papers.why_notable: 行为节律比内容检测更能跨平台迁移，为信息行动筛查提供低数据依赖路径；但共享作息并不支持对具体行动的唯一归因。
papers.abstract: An information operation active on several platforms presents different names, personas, and topics on each. Its working routine is harder to change. We call this routine the operation's production signature: the regularities in when and how its accounts post, reply, and repost. We measure it from timestamps and coarse action types only, using no content, profile metadata, or network ties, as timing and action profiles for accounts and learned action-gap policies for populations. We then ask which parts of a signature carry over to another platform and which belong to a single operation. We train models on Twitter archives of four state-linked operations and apply them to Internet Research Agency (IRA) accounts on Reddit, with no Reddit training labels. They rank the IRA accounts at AUC 0.90-0.94. Content detectors on the same route fall from 0.98 within a platform to 0.81. Daily phase accounts for most of the transfer. Posting volume reverses direction between platforms, and action mix follows the role accounts hold on each platform. What transfers is not unique to the IRA: a second operation shares the same working-hours window, and action-gap policies separate every operation from organic accounts (AUC 0.96-1.0) without consistently ranking their own operation first. On 938 Telegram channels, groups that forward the same sources keep ordinary hours and pace but publish original posts in the same ten-minute windows more often than chance. This pattern is invisible when accounts are examined one at a time. Our results suggest that timing and action traces learned on one platform can help flag likely operations on another.

papers.title: The Vulnerability Window: Decision Instability in Quantized Reward Models
papers.brief: 研究系统评估奖励模型与生成式裁判的四比特量化，追踪偏好翻转及下游选择变化。以全精度评分间隔定位易受量化噪声影响的脆弱窗口。
papers.tldr: 四比特量化可在准确率几乎不变时改写偏好决策，并显著改变候选选择
papers.what_it_is: 研究系统评估奖励模型与生成式裁判的四比特量化，追踪偏好翻转及下游选择变化。以全精度评分间隔定位易受量化噪声影响的脆弱窗口。
key_points: 覆盖8个奖励模型、3个生成式裁判和4种量化器
RewardBench偏好翻转率达1.1%—12.3%
best-of-64选择改变14.6%—65.7%
papers.why_notable: 揭示总体准确率会掩盖相互抵消的决策变化；偏好翻转率比准确率更能反映下游选择漂移，为量化评估提供更有效的诊断依据。
papers.abstract: Reward models and LLM judges are routinely quantized to 4 bits so that scoring many candidates stays affordable, and the usual check is that benchmark accuracy barely moves. That check is close to blind. Across eight reward models from two families (0.6B-8B), three generative judges and four 4-bit quantizers, quantization rewrites 1.1-12.3% of pairwise preference decisions on RewardBench while aggregate accuracy moves by as little as 0.03 points (p = 1.00), because the errors it fixes and introduces cancel. Flips concentrate where the full-precision margin is small relative to the quantization noise scale sigma: a Gaussian approximation Phi(-|m|/sigma) describes the aggregate rate, over-predicting it in all 30 scalar settings and failing for generative judges, and occupancy of the resulting vulnerability window falls from 25% to 7% with model size, which is what makes small judges fragile. The churn stays within noise under benign best-of-16 and becomes clear under adversarial pressure for some quantizers (146:54 harmful:helpful flips on one family, reversing sign on another). Downstream it changes what ships: across six (model, quantizer) pairs from two families, 14.6-65.7% of problems get a different best-of-64 selection while only 2.6-9.6% get a different final answer, with selections changing 5-8x more often than answers in every pair, and the pair the benchmark calls identical (0.03 points, p = 1.00) still changes 34.5% of them. Benchmark churn ranks that downstream change (rho = 0.89); benchmark accuracy does not order it reliably. Held-out audits then locate the useful diagnostic in the margin rather than the Gaussian: every margin-based predictor orders flips identically (AUC 0.927), and on the level a directly measured churn rate wins in-distribution. As a routing signal it is matched by plain top-k. The contribution is the characterization, not the model.

papers.title: Reasoning in Two Dimensions: Quantifying Chain-of-Thought Faithfulness and Efficiency
papers.brief: 将思维链表示为语义推理图，按语义支持与额外历史、通向答案与偏离路径两轴分解预测依赖，构建全局及步骤级指标，并设计图感知微调目标。
papers.tldr: 用语义推理图量化思维链的忠实性与效率，揭示答对不等于推理可靠。
papers.what_it_is: 将思维链表示为语义推理图，按语义支持与额外历史、通向答案与偏离路径两轴分解预测依赖，构建全局及步骤级指标，并设计图感知微调目标。
key_points: 受控干预验证指标能识别隐性依赖与偏离路径推理
数学与多跳任务中，不忠实性关联更高预测不确定性
图感知微调无需直接优化昂贵指标，且不损害准确率
papers.why_notable: 把推理质量从准确率和篇幅扩展到依赖是否忠实、分配是否有效，并提供可训练的改进目标，为思维链评估补上两个关键维度。
papers.abstract: Chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning exposes intermediate steps, but a correct answer does not establish that an LLM relies on the dependence expressed by those steps or reasons efficiently. We operationalize CoT faithfulness and efficiency within a common framework. Specifically, we represent a CoT as a semantic reasoning graph and decompose the model's predictive dependence along two complementary axes: dependence explained by semantic support versus additional reasoning history, and dependence allocated to answer-reaching versus off-path reasoning. This decomposition yields global and step-level measures of unfaithfulness and inefficiency. Controlled interventions show that the proposed metrics respond to hidden dependence and induced off-path reasoning as intended. Across mathematical and multi-hop reasoning tasks, answer-level unfaithfulness is consistently associated with greater predictive uncertainty, whereas both unfaithfulness and inefficiency exhibit weak or inconsistent associations with answer correctness. We further derive theoretically grounded, graph-aware fine-tuning objectives that improve the targeted reasoning properties without directly optimizing the computationally expensive metrics or compromising answer accuracy. Results indicate that accuracy and brevity provide incomplete assessments of reasoning quality: reliable CoT evaluation should also consider whether the LLM's predictive dependence is faithfully represented and efficiently allocated.

papers.title: ORION: Exact Canonical-State Supervision for Systematic Generalization in Transformers
papers.brief: ORION用辅助预测头监督精确的规范执行状态，将隐表示轨迹锚定到有效计算状态。它针对深层执行中的状态漂移，与处理位置问题的RoPE互补。
papers.tldr: 通过精确执行状态监督纠正推理漂移，与旋转位置编码互补提升长度和深度外推。
papers.what_it_is: ORION用辅助预测头监督精确的规范执行状态，将隐表示轨迹锚定到有效计算状态。它针对深层执行中的状态漂移，与处理位置问题的RoPE互补。
key_points: 预注册2×2实验覆盖Folding、GridShift及CLRS-30
RoPE长度外推达59.8%，ORION深度外推达66.7%
联合外推呈严格加性增益；哈希状态统计监督无效
papers.why_notable: 将长度与深度外推失败拆成可分别干预的两条轴，并用负对照表明精确状态对齐的重要性，为系统性泛化提供明确训练抓手。
papers.abstract: Autoregressive Transformers generally fail on out-of-distribution reasoning due to two primary reasons: positional corruption over long sequences and structural state drift across deep execution steps. We introduce ORION, a framework that supervises exact canonical execution states via auxiliary heads to anchor latent trajectories to valid computational manifolds. Across Folding, GridShift, and CLRS-30, a pre-registered 2 x 2 factorial shows that RoPE and ORION address orthogonal axes. RoPE recovers length extrapolation (59.8%), while ORION recovers depth extrapolation (66.7%). Moreover, their combination complementarily achieves strict additive gain in joint length-depth extrapolation, while either method alone offers near satisfactory results. Negative controls confirm that the gain depends strictly on exact canonical alignment; hashed state statistics fail to constrain depth extrapolation.

papers.title: How Much of a Calculation-Error Rate Is Not Arithmetic: Auditing the FinReason Cup 2026 Task 3 Metric with a Deterministic Rule System
papers.brief: 研究重建三项财务数据质量规则，以无训练的确定性系统审计赛事指标。结合公开榜单与逐规则错误分析，给出被误归为计算错误的非算术失误下界。
papers.tldr: 确定性规则系统揭示金融推理榜单中，领先系统的计算错误几乎均非算术失误。
papers.what_it_is: 研究重建三项财务数据质量规则，以无训练的确定性系统审计赛事指标。结合公开榜单与逐规则错误分析，给出被误归为计算错误的非算术失误下界。
key_points: DQC_US_0015的110个练习案例答案均为报告值取负
并列第一的计算错误至少11/12、12/13无需算术
确定性系统1.4秒处理680例，测试准确率95.29%
papers.why_notable: 用可复现规则执行与榜单下界分析，揭示计算错误标签混入事实或路径错误，为金融推理评测的指标解释与修订提供依据。
papers.abstract: Task 3 of the FinReason Cup 2026 scores a system on two values per case, the one an XBRL filing reports and the one its own calculation relationships imply, and labels each failure as structural, extraction or calculation. This report shows that the calculation-error rate so defined does not count arithmetic failures, and bounds how far it is from one using the published board alone. One of the three rules behind the benchmark, DQC_US_0015, has an answer that is the negation of the reported value (in all 110 published practice cases, against 1 of 120 and 6 of 102 for the other two), so a calculation label on such a case records a wrong fact or a wrong route, not a wrong sum. Subtracting the available structural and extraction labels from each entry's error count on that rule gives a floor: the bound is positive for 22 of the 23 ranked entries, and at the top it is sharpest, with at least 11 of 12 and 12 of 13 calculation errors of the two joint-first entries falling on cases where no arithmetic remained. The calculation-error rate of the best systems on this task is almost entirely not arithmetic. The vehicle for that result is an entry that reconstructs the three data-quality rules the benchmark is drawn from, DQC_US_0015, DQC_US_0117 and DQC_US_0126, as a deterministic system with no learned parameters, no training step and no external service, running all 680 cases in 1.4 seconds. It scores 96.62% under the offline judge on development and 95.29% on the published test set, and its residual error concentrates in cases where a concept carries several equally flagged facts and the question names no dimensional member. Reading those error classes against the per-rule accuracies is what exposed the metric, which is why both are reported here.

papers.title: What Does Matching a Human Intervention Effect Establish? Benchmark Checks for LLM Simulations
papers.brief: 研究用零效应参照审查大模型模拟的等价检验，区分宽松容差下的通过与真实响应证据，并结合七十项实验重分析和预注册审计验证。
papers.tldr: 大模型模拟通过人类效应等价检验，未必证明其真实响应了干预。
papers.what_it_is: 研究用零效应参照审查大模型模拟的等价检验，区分宽松容差下的通过与真实响应证据，并结合七十项实验重分析和预注册审计验证。
key_points: 70项实验中，GPT-4的等价通过有72%属零参照通过
GPT-4通过16个零参照失败的对比，无响应预期为1.58个
Claude规范信念变化0.065 SD，人类为0.351 SD
papers.why_notable: 它揭示等价通过可能仅反映容差与统计精度，而非模拟有效性；建议每次等价判定同时报告零参照阈值，提升验证可解释性。
papers.abstract: LLM simulations are validated by equivalence with human effects, yet a zero reference passes whenever the human 90 percent interval lies inside the margin, as the human benchmark shows before simulation. When the zero reference fails, planned precision gives independent simulations the margin up to which passing is a 5 percent test of response. In an exploratory 70-experiment reanalysis, 72 percent of GPT-4's $\pm$0.20 SD passes were zero-reference passes; GPT-4 passed 16 contrasts the zero reference failed (1.58 expected without response). In a preregistered audit, Claude Sonnet 5.5 passed three intention targets, all zero-reference passes, and the registered belief-gradient control; norm beliefs changed 0.065 SD against humans' 0.351 (zero-reference check added after unblinding; norm beliefs emphasized after inspection). Registered tests detected no overestimation; average-effect intervals excluded overestimation above 0.08 SD. A group audit's precision floor is 1.33 facts against a 2.9-fact effect. Report the zero-reference threshold beside every equivalence decision.

papers.title: Co-Evolving Behavioral Agents and Detectors for Adaptive Information Operations
papers.brief: IO-AI依据真实行动的发帖行为构建智能体，模拟争取互动与规避检测。智能体与检测器交替对抗训练，再按检测难度由易到难训练统一检测器。
papers.tldr: 通过行为智能体与检测器共演化训练，显著提升对自适应信息操纵的识别能力。
papers.what_it_is: IO-AI依据真实行动的发帖行为构建智能体，模拟争取互动与规避检测。智能体与检测器交替对抗训练，再按检测难度由易到难训练统一检测器。
key_points: 20个Twitter行动上，相近误报率下漏检减少65%
未见操作者上的F1从0.62提升至0.81
无标签行为距离与跨群体检测表现相关ρ=-0.58
papers.why_notable: 将检测评估从静态历史样本推进到主动规避的对手，并显示课程式对抗训练可改善跨操作者泛化，为更贴近真实威胁的测试提供路径。
papers.abstract: Detectors of state-sponsored information operations (IOs) are trained on campaigns that platforms have already taken down. They lose much of their accuracy on an actor they have not seen, even though no operator in the archived data is trying to avoid them. A real operator wants two things, to reach an audience and to avoid being caught. We present IO-AI, a framework that gives simulated agents these two capabilities, engagement and evasion, and tests what each one does to detection. The agents are built from the posting behavior of real campaigns and choose the emotion, type, and timing of each post. An agent and a detector then train against each other in turn. We rank the trained agents by how hard they are to detect and train one detector on them from easiest to hardest. On 20 Twitter IO campaigns, this detector reduces missed detections of adaptive agents by 65% relative to a detector trained only on the archived campaigns, at a similar false-alarm rate. On actors it has never seen it reaches an F1 of 0.81, against 0.62. We find that an agent trained to seek engagement becomes easier to catch, because it learns the fast, emotional retweeting that archived campaigns were caught producing. An agent that was trained for engagement before the game keeps its engagement lead after it learns to evade. We also introduce a behavioral distance metric that compares two groups of accounts using only their unlabeled posting histories. The larger the distance between two groups, the worse a detector trained on one does on the other (Spearman rho = -0.58), so the metric can be used to choose which new groups to test first.

papers.title: Double counting in LLM evidence fusion: exact posteriors separate rule compliance from posterior gain
papers.brief: 构建四档证据依赖程度的二元世界，以精确后验作为评估基准。通过配对比较四种模型配置在原始与去重指令下的回答，区分规则遵从与实际收益。
papers.tldr: 精确后验实验表明，模型遵守来源去重规则，不一定能改善证据融合准确性。
papers.what_it_is: 构建四档证据依赖程度的二元世界，以精确后验作为评估基准。通过配对比较四种模型配置在原始与去重指令下的回答，区分规则遵从与实际收益。
key_points: 单报告可靠度设为0.65，评估覆盖2976个世界
零依赖时，两配置744例均遵从规则，后验失配却增加0.044
配对收益可用Brier分数差估计，支持按模型与提示条件决策
papers.why_notable: 将指令遵从与概率预测质量明确分开，为证据去重提供可计算的收益基准，避免把统一规则误当作普遍有效的改进。
papers.abstract: Language models fuse reports in retrieval, multi-agent consensus and agent memory, where treating shared-source reports as independent can double count evidence. A common remedy is an instruction to count each source once. Its value depends on the receiver's raw baseline. Pricing it needs an exact reference. We build the graded-dependence exact reference: binary worlds with single-report reliability 0.65 and four dependence levels, whose disclosed parameters give every world an exact posterior and every rule a target risk. The paired gain protocol scores raw and instructed answers of four configurations on 2,976 worlds. Agreement and gain separate in both directions. At $δ$ = 0, claude-opus-5-5 and gpt-6.1-sol agreed with the rule within 0.001 in 744 of 744, and the instruction raised their posterior mismatch by 0.044; gpt-6-luna agreed in 165 of 744 and gained 0.0140 (95% interval 0.0064 to 0.0219); claude-haiku-5-5's gain moved from -0.0295 ($δ$ = 0) to +0.0302 ($δ$ = 1) (descriptive). The prespecified first-child endpoint contrast, gain at $δ$ = 1 minus $δ$ = 0, was 0.0342 (0.0303 to 0.0382). In the preregistered tests, the raw source-weight contrast was positive (0.259, 95% interval 0.182 to 0.337; Holm rejected zero) and the grouping endpoint difference was not detected (0.0004, -0.0023 to 0.0031). This interval excludes differences larger than 0.0031 in magnitude and lies within the registered precision bound of $\pm$0.0046. The reference prices the rule before any model call. The paired gain, estimable as a Brier difference on labelled deployment items, decides adoption per receiver and prompt condition.

papers.title: When Do LLM-Elicited Priors Help? A Controlled Audit of Language Models as Priors for Small-Sample Bayesian Regression
papers.brief: 审计两档大模型为小样本贝叶斯回归提供系数先验的效果。通过隐藏特征名、使用训练截止后的住房数据及错配特征描述，检验收益与可靠性。
papers.tldr: 受控审计发现，大模型回归先验收益有限，数据驱动尺度与混合策略更安全。
papers.what_it_is: 审计两档大模型为小样本贝叶斯回归提供系数先验的效果。通过隐藏特征名、使用训练截止后的住房数据及错配特征描述，检验收益与可靠性。
key_points: 误差相关性达0.92—0.99，平均20次采样无改善
对比最佳经典先验，4个基准仅1个明确获益
由数据设定先验尺度，使错误中心危害降至四分之一
papers.why_notable: 揭示多次采样并不等于独立证据；18个外部任务中仅6个获益、4个受损，支持证据加权混合而非硬信任门控。
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly asked where to center the coefficients of a small-sample Bayesian regression, but the evidence is unclear: benchmarks are often built to match the prior and models may remember them. We audit this practice with one frontier and one flash-tier model, using hidden feature names, post-cutoff housing data and a pre-specified test that gives features the wrong descriptions. First, the models share their errors (correlation $0.92$--$0.99$ across draws, vendors and paraphrases): averaging $20$ draws is no more accurate than one, and treating draws as independent creates overconfidence. Much of this error comes from reporting each feature's effect alone, not with the others held fixed. Second, against the best classical prior, the LLM center helps clearly on one of four benchmarks (RMSE $-5.8\%$), marginally on two, and hurts mean RMSE on the fourth. Third, the LLM's stated uncertainty is unreliable; letting the data set the prior scale cuts the harm of a wrong center four-fold against a unit-variance prior. A pre-specified external test returned the verdict \textsc{partial}: on $18$ rule-selected problems the center helps on six and hurts on four, and a hard trust gate trusts a harmful prior while an evidence-weighted mixture is safer.

papers.title: Isolating the Language Shell: A Content-Controlled Study of Multilingual Reasoning
papers.brief: 将同一批经验证的英语推理轨迹转换为英语、目标语言和混合语言三种监督形式，微调两个预训练学生模型，隔离语言形式对多语言推理蒸馏的影响。
papers.tldr: 固定推理内容后，监督语言形式仍会影响多语言数学推理准确率与输出语言。
papers.what_it_is: 将同一批经验证的英语推理轨迹转换为英语、目标语言和混合语言三种监督形式，微调两个预训练学生模型，隔离语言形式对多语言推理蒸馏的影响。
key_points: 固定已验证推理内容，对比三种监督语言形式
两个学生模型、三种目标语言、两个难度等级
准确率差异不明确时，输出语言仍可能显著不同
papers.why_notable: 将监督语言形式从生成、翻译和筛选差异中剥离，表明它是蒸馏的独立设计变量，且预训练兼容性不能稳定预测效果。
papers.abstract: Multilingual reasoning distillation requires choosing the language in which teacher reasoning is presented, yet existing recipes often entangle linguistic form with differences in generation, translation, and filtering. We construct content-controlled supervision by rendering the same verified English trajectories into English, translated target-language, and language-mixed shells, and fine-tune two pretrained students in three target languages, evaluating them on multilingual mathematical reasoning at two difficulty levels. Even with the underlying reasoning content held fixed, we find that shell choice can change downstream accuracy, with effects varying across students, languages, and difficulty levels. Pre-training compatibility does not consistently track these outcomes, and even when our tests find no clear accuracy difference between shells, their output-language behavior can still differ substantially. These results suggest that the supervision shell is a distinct design choice in multilingual reasoning distillation.

papers.title: How Far Does Lossless Re-tokenization Move an RLVR Update?
papers.brief: 研究保持文本与奖励不变时，重分词如何改变RLVR更新。通过同批轨迹的规范分词与拆分分词对照，结合表格模型证明及训练审计量化影响。
papers.tldr: 无损重分词也会显著改变可验证奖励强化学习的更新，并呈现一致偏移方向。
papers.what_it_is: 研究保持文本与奖励不变时，重分词如何改变RLVR更新。通过同批轨迹的规范分词与拆分分词对照，结合表格模型证明及训练审计量化影响。
key_points: Qwen2.5-0.5B中拆分约4%词元，更新位移达换批次的0.556倍
四模型中位移随拆分比例增大，同检查点跨批次方向一致
规范分词在18组预注册训练对照中赢14组，总体差异区间含零
papers.why_notable: 揭示文本和奖励相同并不保证训练更新等价，为RLVR数据管线提供检查依据；实际重编码仅触及至多0.08%词元，影响规模需区分。
papers.abstract: Language models assign different probabilities to token sequences that decode to the same string. In reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards (RLVR), a trainer that re-encodes sampled text may train on a different token sequence with the same reward. We ask how far this moves a training update, and whether the movement has a consistent direction. From one checkpoint, we compare updates on the same rollouts, canonical and with selected tokens split into two pieces, against an update on a different batch. On Qwen2.5-0.5B with three-digit addition, splitting about one token in 25 moves the update 0.556 times as far as replacing the batch. The ratio rises with the fraction split in four models and depends on which tokens are split; within a checkpoint, the displacements share a direction across batches. In a tabular model with one table per tokenization and a single sampled string, we prove that whenever two strings below an unsampled prefix differ in probability, only the zero full-gradient step agrees across tokenizations, however it is weighted. In an audit that decodes and re-encodes resampled rollouts, re-encoding touches up to 5.2% of rollouts but at most 0.08% of tokens, far below the split fractions we test. Training on fixed rollouts, the canonical arm finishes ahead in 14 of 18 pre-registered pairs; the interval for the mean accuracy difference includes zero over all pairs and excludes it only under the registered exclusion rule, which favours the canonical arm.

papers.title: NightmareDiscourseBench: A Benchmark Dataset for Fictional Direct Discourse Identification Pipelines
papers.brief: 提出用于评测英语小说直接话语识别流程的新基准。核心做法是以叙事理论建立分类与评估框架，并为12个文本样本配备任务相关元数据。
papers.tldr: 以叙事理论统一小说直接话语分类，构建覆盖多种形式的识别测试集。
papers.what_it_is: 提出用于评测英语小说直接话语识别流程的新基准。核心做法是以叙事理论建立分类与评估框架，并为12个文本样本配备任务相关元数据。
key_points: NightmareDiscourseBench含12个文本样本及相关元数据
基于叙事理论分类、评估多种直接话语形式
梳理公开基准统计与元数据，指出理论不一致及只关注言语的问题
papers.why_notable: 价值在于将评测从单一言语识别扩展到多种直接话语形式，并以理论框架改善分类一致性，为文学文本分析提供更明确的测试依据。
papers.abstract: In this paper we introduce a new benchmark dataset, NightmareDiscourseBench, for testing NLP pipelines that identify forms of direct discourse in English-language fiction. We first review existing publicly available benchmarks (providing summary statistics and reviewing available metadata) for this task, identifying theoretical inconsistency and exclusive focus on speech as primary issues in this domain. We then overview our narrative theory-based framework for classifying and evaluating different forms of direct discourse, and finally describe NightmareDiscourseBench, a new benchmark test set of 12 text samples accompanied by metadata pertinent to the task of direct discourse identification.
